notes.title: Smooth Operators 2 Released!
notes.content:
Finally!

After ~5ish years in the making, Smooth Operators 2 is finally released and ready for everyone to enjoy!

I have yet to post tutorial videos on how to create Scenarios and upload them to Steam Workshop, but it will be uploaded this coming weekend. For those of you who want to head right into Scenario building without tutorials, go ahead (it's not really difficult). =)

Anyway, here we are. I hope you enjoy it, and feel free to join the Discord server and/or engage in the forums here on Steam.
If you find any bugs, please get in touch so that i can fix it! =)

Alright.. have fun! =)

Btw, here's the store page!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/776660/Smooth_Operators_2/

notes.title: Smooth Operators 2 Demo released
notes.content:
[h1]Finally, finally, finally![/h1]

The demo of Smooth Operators 2 is now released and available to download and play. It's almost a full vertical slice of the full experience.

There are three game modes available in the demo;
Normal Career - One client campaign
Hard Career - Two client campaign
Sandbox - Three clients, everything is unlocked


All game modes only allow play until day 35, which is roughly an hour or two of gameplay. Another restriction is that the demo won't allow creation or export of Scenarios.

There might still be some bugs in the game, so please use the Demo feedback forum in the community pages and/or my Discord to report them, and i'll do my best to fix them as soon as possible!

Anyways, i really hope you enjoy the demo, and i'll see you in the forums! =)

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/776660/Smooth_Operators_2/]So head on over to Smooth 2 store page![/url]

notes.title: Trading Cards
notes.content:
Hey all Smooth Operators out there!

Steam Trading Cards are now available for Smooth Operators, and they should drop every 30 something minutes.

There are 6 cards to be collected, that can be crafted into badges in 5 levels.
Also, there are 5 awesome profile backgrounds, one uncommon and one rare. On top of this, there are 5 emoticons, where one is uncommon and one is rare.

So, enjoy!

notes.title: Small August Update
notes.content:
Hey all!

Here's another small update. Another one a bit larger is coming in a while.

So here's what's new:
[list]
[*] The janitors are faster
[*] The janitors only targets workstations where there is currently noone working
[*] The it techs are faster
[*] Extended error logging for failing to save the game
[*] Press enter on credits exits the game immediately
[*] Description of some shopmenu items are changed
[/list]

Enjoy!

notes.title: Another update!
notes.content:
Included in this update:

[list]
[*] The properties of building blocks now shows percentage of Deterioration and Trash levels.
[*] If you fire a thief, and do not have an HR Manager, you do not get a penalty from the Union.
[*] Mouse over a building block shows the Mood of all employees sitting in that building.
[*] Preparations for later updates... =)
[/list]

notes.title: Update time!
notes.content:
So, with this second update to Smooth Operators comes this stuff:
[list]
[*] Bug fix: Achievements. Load up your call center, and all Achievements you've earned ingame will unlock on Steam.
[*] Bulk hiring. Hold Ctrl key while placing a new staff member, and you go directly back to the Shop Menu where you were.
[*] Swap workstations. You can now move a worker to an occupied workplace. The worker will then swap workplace with each other.
[/list]

Awesome, huh! =)

notes.title: First game update
notes.content:
An update to Smooth Operators has been uploaded, containing the following:

[list]
[*] Arrow keys now hold the same function as WASD.
[*] Space/Enter/RightMouse closes messages.
[*] RightMouse closes all menues.
[*] Messages closes automatically after 60 seconds.
[*] Updated text on client campaigns with temporary high/low volumes.
[*] A building can now change which client it's employees works for.
[*] Visible marker shows which buildings a Coach/Manager will work on, when employed.
[*] Staff turnover. Employees won't quit if they are somewhat happy.
[*] Deconstruction of transports and buildings now offer a small cash refund.
[*] Waiting for elevators. Employees now have higher tolerance before getting pissed off.
[*] Client VVGTv has been replaced with Denver Weed Inc.
[/list]

Also, a bug has been corrected:
[list]
[*] Some achievements has not been unlocked on Steam, is now corrected.
[/list]

There's more coming in a later update. More on that later!
